loop_steps.name: BUYER_DATA_ARRIVAL
loop_steps.actor: CEO delivers external data file to machine
loop_steps.machine_action: File placed at known path + SHA-256 computed

loop_steps.name: PROTOCOL_VERIFICATION
loop_steps.machine_action: Verify experiment_id, protocol_version, candidate_id match pre-registered contract (R342)

loop_steps.name: SCIENTIFIC_RESULT_ANALYSIS
loop_steps.machine_action: classify_result_ci() — statistical classification (PASS/FAIL/AMBIGUOUS) against pre-registered thresholds

loop_steps.name: EVIDENCE_CLASSIFICATION
loop_steps.machine_action: classify_evidence() — MODEL_PREDICTED → PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED (if admissible + PASS) or FALSIFIED (if admissible + FAIL)

loop_steps.name: BAYESIAN_BELIEF_UPDATE
loop_steps.machine_action: update_posterior_bayesian() — prior → posterior using external observation likelihoods (R342)

loop_steps.name: KNOWLEDGE_ATOM_CREATION
loop_steps.machine_action: create_knowledge_atom() — lesson learned from external evidence (R342)

loop_steps.name: EIG_RECALCULATION
loop_steps.machine_action: calculate_eig() + recompute_eig_for_portfolio() — expected information gain with updated posterior (R342)

loop_steps.name: NEXT_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION
loop_steps.machine_action: Sort portfolio by EIG/cost → select highest-information next experiment (R342)

loop_steps.name: PACKAGE_V2_GENERATION
loop_steps.machine_action: regenerate_package_v3() — full package regeneration with updated evidence, posterior, EIG, next experiment (R342)

loop_steps.name: DISCOVERY_CONSTRAINT
loop_steps.machine_action: Knowledge atom feeds into discovery engine — future candidates inherit the lesson (R357 buyer_feedback_engine pattern)
